sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Papuacedrus papuana is an evergreen conifer of Maluku and New Guinea. It grows about 16–50 m tall in forests; at high elevations it may take a shrubby form.

sections.title: Branchlets, leaves and cones
sections.text: The branchlets form flattened sprays. The opposite scale-like leaves occur in two forms on adult shoots. The female cones are about 1–2 cm long and bear winged seeds.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: No food use is documented in the sources consulted.
